steps.d: In Content › Documents, press Upload document and choose a PDF up to 100 MB.
Add a title and description, then set status, category, language and tags.
Turn on logo on every page, name watermark and, if you want, block copy and print.
Choose what students can do, then press Upload and publish.
From a course’s Content tab, add the document to any module.

faq.q: How do I sell PDF notes online?
faq.a: Upload the PDF in Content › Documents, set its protection and publish it. Then add it to a module from any course’s Content tab, so students who buy the course can open it.

faq.q: How do I watermark my PDFs?
faq.a: Your academy logo is added to every page before upload, and the name watermark shows each student’s name on every page. If a PDF is passed on, it still carries that student’s name.

faq.q: How do I stop copying and printing of notes?
faq.a: Turn on Block copy and print in the document’s Protection settings. It stops copying text and printing in the app.

faq.q: Can students download the notes again?
faq.a: Yes, if you allow it. Under Students can, let students download again from their library and receive a copy by email when they get access.
